The data of the bornological reflection pair: bornologies, spaces, and the four classes of maps
Bornological maps include identities, compose, and have bornological spaces at both ends
Bornology-reflecting maps include identities, compose, and have bornological spaces at both ends
Bornologically initial maps are exactly those both bornological and bornology-reflecting
Bornological embeddings are exactly the injective bornologically initial maps
Bornological and bornology-reflecting maps form a reflection pair, with both cancellation laws
The inverse of a bornological bijection is bornology-reflecting
The inverse of a bornology-reflecting bijection is bornological
The inverse of a bornologically initial bijection is a bornological embedding
